name: @sos-2/observation-host
description: SOS 2.0 Observation Host (Work Order P7): the composition root of the no-body Observation Plane. A plain Node + TypeScript host (repo-standard ESM + tsc build, no vendor framework — the apps/api + apps/worker-runtimes precedent): assembles the durable in-memory P2 live-store, the P7 event-ingestion pipeline, the telemetry runtime, the live projections, the read-only System State claims port and the observation loop with EVERYTHING injected (clock, sources, claims, wiring). The composition root is the single impure boundary (SystemClock via Date.now — the documented exception; everything deeper is deterministic and offline-testable). Reference event sources are deterministic scripted adapters with explicit simulated markers; real provider endpoints (GitHub webhooks, CI buses, deployment trackers, telemetry backends) attach later behind the same ports reporting honest NOT_YET_CONNECTED until real connection evidence exists. The host runs one bounded drain per tick on an injected tick source — no ambient timers, no long-running work inside any drain.
